summary: Full e2e testing of Smart Pen Knife (Bengali COD landing + admin) — 18/18 backend tests pass, all frontend flows verified: landing render, package selection updates total, order submission with toast success, phone/address validation, admin login (wrong vs right password), dashboard stats, order status update, product save, logout, mobile sticky bar visibility (mobile only).

issues: React dev-mode hydration warning: a <span> appears inside <option>. The warning originates from an injected 'x-component' visual-editor wrapper, not from Landing.jsx code (the JSX is plain text). Non-blocking but worth noting; if seen in production builds, consider rendering option label via a variable to avoid the wrapper auto-injecting children.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, future-proofing).

ProductUpdate.offer_end_iso cannot be set to None via PUT because the route filters out None values (`if v is not None`). If admin wants to clear the offer end, this silently no-ops. Consider using a sentinel or model_fields_set check.
Order/Product mongo writes don't use upsert for `ensure_product`; concurrent first-call could race, but the `if not existing` guard mitigates for normal usage.
AdminDashboard.jsx is ~615 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; OrdersTab / ProductTab could be split into separate files for maintainability.
No rate limit / brute-force protection on /api/admin/login — single-admin password-only auth is by design but a simple delay on wrong password would be prudent.
Frontend allows package <select> change without scrolling; this is OK, just noting that package buttons auto-scroll to order form (intentional UX).
test_credentials: Admin credentials are supplied through environment variables.
seed_data_creation: Test orders are created during test runs (TEST Buyer / TEST Buyer UI) — backend test deletes its own order; the UI test leaves one order in DB. Admin orders list confirmed visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers product GET/PUT (auth), admin login/verify, orders CRUD with status transitions and validation, and stats. Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://sharp-mini-tools.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Landing data-testids: landing-page, hero-title, package-{n}pcs, area-inside-dhaka/outside-dhaka, order-name-input, order-phone-input, order-address-input, order-package-select, qty-increase/decrease, order-total, order-submit-button, mobile-sticky-bar. Admin testids: admin-login-form, admin-password-input, admin-login-button, admin-dashboard, nav-dashboard/orders/product, stat-total-orders, orders-table, status-{id}, delete-{id}, save-product, logout-button. The only console noise on landing is a hydration warning from the visual editor's injected span wrappers inside <option> — not a code bug.
